captions: The unique combination of the nuclear meltdown and toxic flood waters gave birth to a new superhero...!
He was born on a planet of superhuman handsome geniuses and raised on Earth by wild pumas!
Hey Kids!  Don't be the last on your block to own this new superhero action figure!
Because of his brains and purity of heart, he was chosen from Earth's 5 billion inhabitants!
With a mighty clap of thunder he transmogrified into the champion of justice!
Meanwhile, 127 of Retchmaster's henchmen close in!
Suddenly, he was trapped...like a super pickle in a super barrel!
After 200 years of passivity, the Angorian rebels needed him to train them in the art of self-defense.
What a dilemma! Super Guy must  choose between reason and brute force!
Super Guy's perfect physique made him a target of intergalactic zookeepers!
In a rare moment of calm, Super Guy puts on a show for the crowd!
The plan to make the emperor jealous was working!
For the orphanage, Super Guy needed to top Mr. Planet, Mr. Galaxy, Mr. Universe, and Mr. T!
Hopelessly out-numbered, Super Guy contacts the superhero union!
Meanwhile, Super Guy sends out a secret distress call heard only by dogs!
This would stop the eavesdropping fools once and for all!
To escape, Super Guy sounds the mating call of the humongous rampaging Pugabanunu!
Without warning, Super Guy is engulfed by a mysterious swirling mass!
It was more than a hurricane; more than a tornado!  It could only be described as...a hurrnado!
Help!!  Super Guy had fallen into a vortex and couldn't get up!
It was more than a monsoon; more than a tsunami!  It could only be described as...a monstumi!
To stop Disgruntled-Man, Super Guy springs into action!
Suddenly, Super Guy shifts into warp speed!
Just one mighty leap to avoid the flesh-burning molten lava!
The race between Super Guy and Rabbit-Lad was on!
Weary from battle, Super Guy was not prepared for this new onslaught!
Super Guy spies a figure floating above the horizon!  Is it friend...or foe?!
And so concludes another adventure!  What daring feats await Super Guy?!
There was much destruction...but now was a time to rebuild!
Preparing for the cross-comic war, Super Guy arms himself with the latest weaponry!
Uncovering Retchmaster's secret lab, Super Guy slyly disarms his arch enemy!
The world's future was at stake! Super Guy must attempt to harness the power of the gods!
Leaving for battle, Super Guy realizes that his utility belt needs just one more item!
Suddenly, he spots the rare and endangered, yet carnivorous saber-toothed nygak!
A citizen trapped in a burning building! Super Guy acts swiftly!
En route to stopping the rampaging comet, Super Guy spies a helpless kitten, caught in a tree!
Is that shadowy figure about to leap off the bridge?!  No!...not while Super Guy is here!
Orbiting the planet, Super Guy is relieved that the world is safe once more!  Until...
Into the stratosphere!  But is that a satellite on the horizon, or something far more sinister...!
Fly as he might, there was no escaping the space harpies!
His flight was flawless, until he was suddenly overcome by cooties!
Super Guy was free as a bird or, more appropriately, a sitting duck!
There is only one sure way to free Micro-Man...trapped inside of Super Guy's brain!
To demonstrate his super senses, Super Guy smells a flower 300 miles away!
Only a flood-like spray of water could extinguish the rampaging inferno!
The vile criminal then gave Super Guy a dose of industrial-strength pepper spray!
What's this?  A strange numbness overwhelms our hero!
A coldness runs down his spine.  Super Guy senses he is not alone!
The environment suddenly turns uninhabitable!
He was spied upon like an animal in a zoo!  But Super Guy is no ordinary animal!
Super Guy must console the Zirconians using intergalactic sign language!
Interplanetary peace was at stake.  Super Guy responds to their counter-offer with diplomacy!
The fiendish aliens will retreat only if Super Guy can make their melancholic queen smile!
Super Guy decides to beat the Crime Clown at his own game!
Too late!!  Retchmaster's upside-down site was now on line!
Super Guy inched his way toward the anti-gravity machine's disable switch!
Even Super Guy was susceptible to the mischievous topsy-turvy rays!
Super Guy ingeniously solves the mystery of the footprints on the ceiling!
Something was amiss with the President.  Where in the world was the secret service?!
The two ugly space creatures were devouring every planet in their path!  Super Guy flies closer!
Was this an ambush?!  Is this the end of Super Guy?!
Villians are a cowardly lot.  Super Guy decides to even the odds!
There is a time to attack and a time to retreat!  The choice was obvious!
Two of Retchmaster's punks!  Did they feel lucky?!
The plan...act weak to throw them off guard, then pummel them before they knew what hit 'em!
The only way to convince them was a show of super-strength!
Was even Super Guy strong enough for tritanium...the hardest known metal in the universe?!
This is what Super Guy thought of their prison bars!
Super Guy grabbed and diffused the nuclear pipe bomb in the nick of time!
There was no time to lose!  To the Cyboard!
Retchmaster had rigged Super Guy's brakes!  There was only one way to stop!!
Super Guy rode the crest of the tidal wave to safety!
Though still untested, Super Guy put his cyboard into rocket mode!
Temporarily stumped, Super Guy patiently plans his next move!
With the world under Retchmaster's mind control, what of Super Guy?  Continued next issue!
It was the secret plans for world domination!   They were too dangerous for mere mortals!
Super Guy peers into his future with the cosmic almanac!
You could cut the tension with a knife.  This was the final stare-down between Good and Evil!
With his x-ray vision, Super Guy saw that the man indeed had pastrami for lunch!
Using his CAT scan vision, he spotted the brain tumor a mile away!
Super Guy's heat vision turned Frostman into harmless vapor!
Super Guy takes a moment to reflect upon his awesome power!
Weapons of destruction used for good.  Super Guy sheds a tear!
Now he had all the tools needed for his journey to the center of the Earth!
The lesson learned?  With great power comes great responsibility!
Wearing the cloak of invisibility, he secretly listened to their evil plan!
Super Guy forged ahead wearing his antisubatomic radiation shield!
The giant spider spun a web around Super Guy, then closed in!
In gratitude, the planet of Wickwick made Super Guy an honorary Wickerman!
Her parachute had failed!  Super Guy dives at super speed, but is he too late?!
With his last once of strength he leapt in front of the speeding train, saving her from certain death!
Her bungee chord had failed!  Super Guy dives at super speed, but is he too late?!
The fan learned that day that not everyone can fly like Super Guy!
Disguised as a mild-mannered nobody, Super Guy continues to live amongst common earth people!
Like a chameleon, Super Guy demonstrates why he is known as, "The man with a million faces"!
There are times when more can be achieved as a nerd than as a  handsome superhero!
The thugs were dumbfounded!  Which one was Retchmaster and which was Super Guy in disguise?!
The situation called for a victory dance!
He was not only as strong as 100 beings, but lithe and nimble as well!
Super Guy rejoices that the world is safe again!
Super Guy signals farewell as he flies off into the sunset!
The time-space continuum has been disrupted!  Super Guy was trapped in a continuous loop!
Caught in the deadly centrifuge, Super Guy senses the waves of unconsciousness engulf him!
Retchmaster had him trapped!  If he could free just one hand and fly to safety!
'Round and 'round he goes!  Where he stops only the Crime Clown knows!
A human pendulum!  Is this the end of Super Guy?!
Suddenly confronted by the sorceress, Super Guy acts swiftly in the opposite direction!
Super Guy must retreat to the Fortitude of Solace before taking on such a foe!
It was an act foreign to him, but Super Guy realizes he must run away!
Sensing kryptonite, Super Guy realizes he must run away!
It was an act foreign to him, but Super Guy realizes he must run away!
Sensing kryptonite, Super Guy realizes he must run away!
Sensing kryptonite, Super Guy realizes he must run away!
He now stands face to face with pure evil!  Goodness triumphs again!
Backed against the wall, Super Guy lashes out!
What makes the muskrat guard her musk?...Courage!
Super Guy could hold back no more!
He contorted his face into a grimace that froze them in their tracks!
He reached down within himself and morphed out the spirit of the tiger!
It's the cereal of Super Guys! "They're greeeeaaaat!"
"Thank you for saving my life, Super Guy!" she said.
"I'm the president of your fan club, Super Guy!" she said.
"You are the greatest superhero of them all, Super Guy!" she said.
Something is amiss.  There was no loitering around the command center!
Super Guy's sixth sense picks up a crime in progress!
Wasn't that the galaxy's most wanted criminal?!  Super Guy investigates!
Super Guy had finally tracked down Retchmaster!  But where was the hostage?!
